title: Hierarchical Request Thread Facets — interactive drilldown for correlation contexts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Proposal for a hierarchical, facet-driven request drilldown UI that centers correlation IDs and request threads. The goal is to let SREs and product engineers quickly pivot from a noisy timeline to focused causal paths across services, with progressive disclosure to handle very long traces. Key problems: long tail of spans, difficulty correlating events across retries/batches, and lack of fast filters for contextual facets (service, route, model, error-class, kv-cache-hit).
acceptance_criteria: Users can filter a request list by at least five native facets (correlation_id, service, route, status_code, error_class) and combine them with boolean operators
A trace view can collapse/expand hierarchical thread groups (eg. retried subrequests) and preserve a focused time window without reloading the entire trace
Deep links to a selected facet+time-range are generated (URL + copyable anchor) and open the console to the same state
Prototype performs acceptably on traces with >2000 spans by sampling UI rendering and showing a progressive 'loading window' with heatmap summary
Design includes keyboard navigation for primary actions and passes basic a11y color contrast checks
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Chen: Initial sketch uploaded to Figma and high-level PRD drafted. Holding early alignment with Eng on API surface for facet extraction (we need correlation_id as first class field).

2026-03-11 Luca Romano: Engineering review — backend can emit 'thread_id' with parent pointers; concern about loading 2k+ spans in DOM. Suggested progressive rendering and server-side aggregation for heatmap overview. Action: Eng to prototype server aggregation endpoint (ENG-19844).

2026-03-11 Priya Patel (PM): Prioritize correlation-first flows for incident response. Add 'error_class' and 'model_variant' as default facets. We've seen customer-reported incidents where model fallback caused multi-service retries — having model variant in the facet is high value.

2026-03-12 Design review notes: Reduce visual density by collapsing consecutive no-op spans into a single mini-tile. Replace full timestamp text with relative offsets when zoomed out. Add affordance for 'Show all spans in time window' to temporarily expand sampling.
2026-03-12 Accessibility feedback from QA: Ensure keyboard focus order for facet chips and timeline zoom controls. Provide visible focus ring and ARIA labels for expandable thread groups.
2026-03-12 Luca Romano: Implementing mock endpoint for heatmap aggregation; opened ENG-19844 and linked PR. Will trial WebWorker-based rendering to keep main thread responsive.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: show full span waterfall vs summarized thread tiles. Chose summary-by-default with expand-on-demand to preserve investigator speed.
Performance plan: server-side aggregation to compute heatmap buckets, client sampling for initial render, progressive expansion for selected window.
Follow-ups: include cost attribution overlay in a later iteration to correlate expensive traces with model-serving cost centers (link to roadmap item PM-78).
